name: Ride A Pet
summary: Ride A Pet has no code redemption menu yet. Here's what that means, and where codes will show up first when they arrive.
about:
Ride A Pet is a Roblox pet game by the group "this game is gud". Eggs appear around the map, and taking one starts a break timer, usually 20 or 30 seconds, that you have to beat. Get it home and it hatches at a nest on your plot.

Faster mounts reach the far spawns before the timer runs out, feeding your pets makes them stronger, and weather events can mutate pets and eggs for big multipliers. Later on it's about rebirths, money, and luck upgrades, since luck decides which pet a rare egg actually gives you.
codesNote:
Ride A Pet has no working codes right now, and that isn't because we couldn't find any. The game doesn't have a code redemption menu yet, so there's nowhere to type one even if it existed.

Plenty of Roblox games launch without one and add it later as they grow, so codes may well arrive in a future update. When they do, they'll be announced in the game's Discord or on its Roblox page first, and this page will be updated the same day.

In the meantime, ignore any site or video listing "working codes" for this game, and stay away from scripts promising free cash or auto-farming. Those are exploits, they break Roblox's rules, and they can get your account banned.
